import numpy as np
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor

try:
    from treehfd import XGBTreeHFD
except Exception:
    XGBTreeHFD = None


def _base(model, X_train, X_test, order=2):
    hfd = XGBTreeHFD(model)
    hfd.fit(X_train, interaction_order=order, verbose=False)
    out = []
    for X in (X_train, X_test):
        y_main, y_o2 = hfd.predict(X, verbose=False)
        comps = {(j,): np.asarray(y_main[:, j], float) for j in range(y_main.shape[1])}
        for k, (a, b) in enumerate(hfd.interaction_list):
            comps[(int(a), int(b))] = np.asarray(y_o2[:, k], float)
        out.append(comps)
    return float(hfd.eta0), out[0], out[1]


def decompose(model, X_train, X_test, rounds=2, shrink=0.5):
    X_train = np.asarray(X_train, float)
    X_test = np.asarray(X_test, float)
    eta0, ctr, cte = _base(model, X_train, X_test)
    ytr = model.predict(X_train)
    # Per-component smoothers refit on residual (own variables only).
    # Subsample the training set for speed.
    n = X_train.shape[0]
    if n > 5000:
        idx = np.random.RandomState(0).choice(n, 5000, replace=False)
    else:
        idx = np.arange(n)
    keys = list(ctr.keys())
    for _ in range(rounds):
        for k in keys:
            res = ytr - eta0 - sum(ctr.values())
            cols = list(k)
            g = GradientBoostingRegressor(
                n_estimators=30, max_depth=2 if len(k) == 2 else 3,
                learning_rate=0.1, random_state=0)
            g.fit(X_train[idx][:, cols], res[idx])
            ptr = shrink * g.predict(X_train[:, cols])
            pte = shrink * g.predict(X_test[:, cols])
            # keep the training-mean of the component fixed to avoid
            # shifting into the intercept
            m = ptr.mean()
            ctr[k] = ctr[k] + ptr - m
            cte[k] = cte[k] + pte - m
    return eta0, cte


def _winsorise_components(components, lower=0.01, upper=0.99):
    """Clip every component to its own quantile range (a step the paper does not describe)."""
    clipped = {}
    for key, values in components.items():
        lo, hi = np.quantile(values, [lower, upper])
        clipped[key] = np.clip(values, lo, hi)
    return clipped
